body:
Before I started steroids I was 5'11 180 pounds at 10% bodyfat. I had an ok build but always wanted more. My lifts for the Big 3 before I started were 245 Bench, 335 Squat, and 425 Deadlift. I had played football in high school but was always that skinny guy. My lower body was decent in terms of strength but my upper body always lagged. It took me awhile to bench 2 plates.
Fast forward a few years and I was approached by a friend of mine who was in a 'top frat' at school. This house was well known for having the looks and they were all in stellar shape. Basically my boy had offered me a few compounds. I went home that day and did my research. I researched cycle lengths, PCT, AIs, SERMs, side effects and how to keep your gains. After a few months of solid diet, training, and research I hit my friend up on the offer.
After a few months of solid diet, training, and research I hit my friend up on the offer.
I began pinning 75 mg of Trenbolone Acetate every other day for 10 weeks and 500 mg of Testosterone Enanthate spread out over 2 pinnings every week for 15 weeks. I had Clomid, HCG, and Nolva on hand for PCT and arimidex for an AI to control bloat, gyno, and ball shrinkage.
The cycle:
Most people like to kickstart a test cycle with dianabol for the first 4-6 weeks, however, I was using a very strong compound in Tren and decided to ditch the dbol. The first three weeks nothing really happened. But towards the end of the third week the tren started to kick in. Night sweats, mood swings, poor cardio performance, and the dreams. Omg the dreams were a trip! I have taken LSD, MDMA, mushrooms, vicodin, weed, hash, and alcohol, but none of those drugs can compare to gear. My dreams were weirder than the trips I would have off of acid and shrooms. For example, I had one dream where I was having sex with my ex girlfriend in the middle of a crowded subway in manhattan, I live in cali btw, she then busts out a knife and starts stabbing an old man sitting next to us. She proceeds to eat his liver and brains as I am there with my pants down watching her. I then somehow end up smoking weed in the middle of a walmart with my parents. When we are done clearing the bowl, I pick up a fork that was on the ground and start stabbing all of the fish in the pet section. After I'm done. I break all of the tanks, rip off my shirt and start making pig noises as I'm sprinting out of the walmart. I then steal a cop car and run it through an In-N-Out where I sustain horrible injuries and am left to die. Dreams as weird and random as that occur nightly until I stop taking the tren.
By week 4 I am definitely starting to feel the effects of the tren. Strength is starting to increase and I am looking harder and more vascular. My shoulders and traps start to explode. The test started working by week 5, which was the most intense week.
The test started working by week 5, which was the most intense week.
The test and tren were kicking into full force. I was repping my one rep max on bench for a total of 8 times. All my lifts were up, the pumps were crazy, my body looked fuller, more dense, and vascular. People who hadn't seen me in a few weeks accused me of taking steroids hehe. I never had a problem with acne, so I didn't really have any break outs during the cycle, which was good. From week 5 onwards I kept making serious gains, both aesthetically and strength-wise. My problem areas were growing like weeds and everyone was amazed at my progress. Girls started noticing me more and people began talking about me like crazy.
Overall: I went from 180 pounds to 205 pounds, a 25 pound gain in lean mass, of which I lost 6 pounds. Bodyfat went from 10% to 8%, vascularity was up, I looked jacked AF, and all of my lifts increased. 1 rep maxes after for my big 3 were 305 for bench, 445 for squat, and 560 for deadlift. Tren and test increased my lifts like crazy as well as my lean muscle mass. It was well worth the trouble.
